title: Why James Webb's Mirrors Are Made of Pure Gold #Shorts
description:
Why James Webb's Mirrors Are Made of Pure Gold. Ever wondered why the mirrors are gold!? Here is the mind-blowing science explained in seconds.

THE SCIENCE EXPLAINED:
The James Webb Space Telescope features eighteen giant hexagonal mirrors coated in pure vaporized gold. Gold reflects ninety-eight percent of infrared light, allowing Webb to peer over thirteen point five billion years back in time to capture the very first stars ever formed after the Big Bang.
